How this works

The published adfly model runs the full fly brain and ventral nerve cord. We changed Kenyon-cell thresholds by −1 mV, thinned outgoing contacts with 30% probability, and silenced cells with 17% probability. These are exploratory settings. The picture illustrates those operations; only the output numbers are measured simulation results. Higher output does not automatically mean healthier function.
